entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is David. How can I help you today?
Finally! I've been on hold forever. I bought a pair of your so-called 'performance' cycling shoes and they're complete garbage. I want my money back, now!
I'm very sorry to hear you're having trouble with your shoes. I can definitely look into this for you. To get started, could I get your name and order number?
The name is Mark Peterson, order number is VF887-21. And don't give me the runaround. These things gave me the worst blisters I've ever had. It's completely unacceptable.

I understand your frustration, Mark. Thank you for that information. Let me pull up your order. Just to be clear, what specifically is the issue with the shoes? Is it a technical fault or a matter of comfort and preference?

Are you listening to me?! I said I have massive blisters! I've tried adjusting the cleats a dozen times, I've worn different socks, nothing works. Your cycling shoes are defective and they're tearing my feet apart. I want a refund.
Okay, I see. I'm pulling up your order details now. It looks like the shoes were delivered 37 days ago. Let me just review our return policy for you.

37 days? I don't care if it's been 37 years! The product is a failure. Are you going to process this refund or do I need to speak to your manager? I swear I will write a review on every single website about how VeloFit sells painful, defective garbage.
That won't be necessary, sir. I've just confirmed the policy. Your item is a standard product and is well within our 90-day return window. I can absolutely process a full refund for you.
Oh. Okay, well... good. That's what I expected.

Of course. I've just initiated the return process on my end. I'm emailing you a pre-paid shipping label right now. Just pack the shoes in their original box, attach the label, and drop them off at any post office. Once we receive the item, your refund will be processed back to your original payment method within 3-5 business days.
Alright. I got the email. So I just send the shoes back and I get the money? That's it?

That's correct. We'll handle everything from there. Again, I do apologize for the trouble with the blisters and the negative experience you had with our cycling shoes. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
No, that's it. Just make sure that refund comes through.
I will personally ensure it's monitored. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a good day.
